summary: A parent from Harwood Unified Union School District urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program, emphasizing the essential role of reliable broadband in modern education and the direct impact of E-Rate cuts on school budgets and services.

claims.argument: Reducing or eliminating E-Rate support would result in direct and tangible cuts to schools' budgets, leading to service reductions for students
claims.evidence_quote: Over the past three school years our district has cut spending by about $7.5 million, including eliminating over 50 jobs. Yet, despite similar desperate cost-cutting efforts by all our school boards, our state has instituted a cost threshold for school budgets that will severely penalize my district's already stripped budget. Losing E-rate funding will immediately and unavoidably result in cuts to direct services to our kids.
